title: PR #12: feat: executable end-to-end ecosystem integration
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

Implements the first executable cross-component system contract.

- repairs the ATC node runtime module declaration
- adds a root Cargo workspace for the integration boundary
- composes canonical atc-sdk TransactionBuilder with atc-node Runtime
- verifies shared chain ID, deterministic transaction identity and signed transaction admission
- adds a GitHub Actions integration gate

This keeps domain logic in the canonical component repositories while making the umbrella repository executable as an integration system.
